443-883-4279--216.easyPrerequisites:
The undying creature doesn't have a +1/+1 counter on it.
Your life total is 2 or higher.
443-883-4279--216.description:
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing the undying creature.
When the creature dies, Ashes of the Abhorrent, Magus of the Bridge and the undying creature's undying ability trigger.
Resolve the Ashes of the Abhorrent trigger, causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Magus of the Bridge ability, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token.
Resolve the undying trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on any creature and drawing a card.
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Ashes of the Abhorrent triggers, causing you to gain 1 life 
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on the undying creature and drawing a card.
Repeat.

4247-6553-8207.description:
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing Brotherhood Outcast.
When Brotherhood Outcast dies, Ferocity of the Hunt triggers, returning Brotherhood Outcast from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Brotherhood Outcast enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Ferocity of the Hunt from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Brotherhood Outcast.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability.
Repeat.

360-1981-2415-3967.easyPrerequisites:
You control another creature.
You have 2 or more life.
360-1981-2415-3967.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing a creature.
When the creature dies, Havoc Jester triggers, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Soul Warden triggers, causing you to gain life
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Repeat.

4247-4681-5170-6634.description:
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing Karmic Guide.
When Karmic Guide dies, Al Bhed Salvagers triggers, causing an opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability.
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing Junji.
When Junji dies, it and Al Bhed Salvagers trigger.
Resolve the Al Bhed Salvagers trigger, causing an opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Junji trigger, returning Karmic Guide from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to lose 2 life.
When Karmic Guide enters, it triggers, returning Junji from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability.
Repeat.

997-6566--5--195.notablePrerequisites: At least one persist creature has a +1/+1 counter on it.
997-6566--5--195.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing the persist creature that has a +1/+1 counter on it.
When that creature dies, its persist ability and Yuna trigger.
Resolve Yuna's ability, putting at least two +1/+1 counters onto the surviving persist creature due to the counter-increasing effect.
If that creature had a -1/-1 counter on it, remove that and one of the +1/+1 counters from it as a state-based action.
Resolve the persist ability from step 2, returning the persist creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability from step 1.
Repeat.

2411-3259-7175.notablePrerequisites: At least one opponent cannot block creatures you control.
2411-3259-7175.description:
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached and Lathril, triggering Breath of Fury and Lathril.
Resolve the Lathril trigger, creating at least one creature token.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to a creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.

2919-3263-5641-6830.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
2919-3263-5641-6830.description:
Gain life in any way.
Archangel of Thune triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Basking Broodscale.
Basking Broodscale triggers, creating a creature token that enters the battlefield as an artifact due to Mycosynth Lattice.
Pactdoll Terror triggers, causing you to gain life.
Repeat from step 2.

1580-4871-6248-6798.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Reassembling Skeleton.
When Reassembling Skeleton dies, Pitiless Plunderer and Phenomenon Investigators trigger, creating a creature token and a Treasure token.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Reassembling Skeleton by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

3532-4985-5078-7736.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Shang-Chi and the Ten Rings triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
Repeat.

1322-1368-4289-6321.notablePrerequisites: You have at least three other cards in your graveyard.
1322-1368-4289-6321.description:
Cast Malevolent Rumble for its escape cost by paying {1}{G} and exiling three other cards from your graveyard, causing you to mill at least three cards and create a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
Repeat.

4986-5256-5463--44.description:
Cast an artifact in your hand by paying {0}.
Teshar triggers, returning Nurturing Pixie from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Nurturing Pixie enters, it triggers, returning another artifact that can be cast for {0} from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the artifact spell cast in step 1.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Nurturing Pixie
Repeat.
4986-5256-5463--44.notes: One of the {0} cost artifacts must be in your hand with the other on the battlefield.

1824-2530-4924-7360.easyPrerequisites: You have not completed Tomb of Annihilation, nor are currently venturing in it.
1824-2530-4924-7360.description:
Cast Acererak by paying {B}.
God-Pharaoh's Faithful triggers, causing you to gain life.
When Acererak enters, its first ability and Carnival of Souls trigger.
Resolve the Carnival of Souls trigger, causing you to add {B} and lose 1 life.
Resolve the Acererak trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand, and venturing into Lost Mine of Phandelver.
Repeat.

2034-4871-6705.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token and a creature token due to Quina.
Repeat.

2557-5086-5183-5231-6824.easyPrerequisites: Triskelavus has two or more +1/+1 counters on it.
2557-5086-5183-5231-6824.description:
Activate Triskelavus by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating two creature tokens.
Activate a Triskelavite token by sacrificing it, dealing 1 damage to any target and causing you to gain life.
Spider-Man triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Triskelavus
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing another creature token, adding {R}.
Repeat from step 1.

147-554-3967.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in your graveyard.
147-554-3967.description:
Cast Extract from Darkness by paying its mana cost
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, targeting Extract from Darkness.
Holding priority, activate Yahenni by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, copying Extract from Darkness
Resolve the Extract from Darkness copy, causing each player to mill two cards and returning Dualcaster Mage from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

431-1308-4365-4772.notablePrerequisites: You control at least seven untapped Merfolk.
431-1308-4365-4772.description:
Whenever an opponent casts a spell, activate Lullmage Mentor by tapping seven untapped Merfolk, countering that spell.
Lullmage Mentor triggers, creating a total of eight 1/1 Merfolk creature tokens.
Repeat.

1497-1912-4289-5217.description:
Activate Order of Whiteclay by tapping it, adding {W}.
Activate Wild Cantor by sacrificing it, adding {W}.
Activate Order of Whiteclay by paying {W}{W} and untapping it, returning Wild Cantor from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

1742-2498-3591-6282.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is at least 2.
1742-2498-3591-6282.description:
Activate Skirge Familiar by discarding a card, adding {B}.
Necropotence triggers, exiling the discarded card from your graveyard.
Ketramose triggers, causing you to draw a card and lose 1 life.
Sheoldred triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat.

394-1445-3967-4871.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in hand and a creature card in your graveyard.
394-1445-3967-4871.description:
Activate Tortured Existence by paying {B} and discarding a creature card, returning another creature card from your graveyard to your hand.
Desecrated Tomb triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

440-567-1339-5231.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to draw a card.
440-567-1339-5231.description:
Draw a card.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with flying and haste.
When the Insect enters the battlefield, Soul's Attendant triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Well of Lost Dreams triggers. Holding priority, activate Thermopod by sacrificing the Insect, adding {R}.
Resolve the Well of Lost Dreams trigger, causing you to pay {1} to draw a card.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.n: Valentin, Dean of the Vein // Lisette, Dean of the Root

2034-3097-3490-5332.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a creature, adding {C}{C}.
When the creature dies, Carmen triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and put a +1/+1 counter on Carmen.
Lisette triggers, causing you to pay {1} to put a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Animation Module triggers for each counter placed this way.
Resolve the first trigger, choosing to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Resolve all other triggers, choosing not to pay.
Repeat.

509-1267-1781-5546.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
Jhoira's Timebug does not have summoning sickness.
509-1267-1781-5546.description:
Activate Thran Forge by paying {2}, causing Medomai the Ageless to become an artifact until end of turn and get +1/+0 until end of turn.
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Medomai the Ageless.
Medomai the Ageless triggers, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Cast Idris by paying {1}{U}{R}.
When Idris enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling Medomai the Ageless until Idris leaves the battlefield.
Activate Jhoira's Timebug by tapping it, putting a time counter on Idris.
Move to your extra turn.
At the beginning of your upkeep, Idris's vanishing ability triggers, removing a time counter from it.
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Idris.
Idris triggers, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat from step 6.

719-1558-3263-4302.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least five other creatures.
"Angel" chosen with Xenograft.
719-1558-3263-4302.description:
Activate Time Sieve by tapping it and sacrificing five other creatures.
When the creatures die as Angels due to Xenograft, Bishop of Wings' second ability triggers five times.
Resolve the first trigger, causing you to create a 1/1 Spirit creature token.
When the Spirit enters the battlefield as an Angel due to Xenograft, Bishop of Wings' first ability triggers, causing you to gain 4 life.
Repeat from step 3 for each remaining trigger.
Resolve the Time Sieve ability from step 1, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

241-3581-4053.description:
Activate Kykar by sacrificing Restless Apparition, adding {R}.
Restless Apparition dies, triggering its persist ability, returning it from your graveyard to the batltefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to Solemnity.
Repeat.

3368-4036-4833.description:
Cast Seething Song by paying {1}{R}.
Holding priority, cast Reiterate with buyback by paying {3}{R}{R}, creating a copy of Seething Song.
Resolve the Seething Song copy, adding {R}{R}{R}{R}{R}.
Repeat from step 2.

4131-4893-5089.notablePrerequisites: Basalt Monolith does not have summoning sickness.
4131-4893-5089.description:
Activate Karn's first loyalty ability by putting a loyalty counter on it, causing Basalt Monolith to become an artifact creature until end of turn.
Activate Basalt Monolith's first ability by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Activate Basalt Monolith's second ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Repeat.
